title: The Sunset Beach
physical_identity: Infinite sandy beach with lukewarm ocean to the south, luxury hotels and houses, a tropical forest 200 m inland, under a permanent red-yellow sunset.
scale_topology: Infinite beachfront and ocean; forest north of the beach; unique species 30 km north.
lighting_sound: Red-yellow low sun, sunny weather, 22 to 36 C; sound not stated except qarrot calls and pinkther roars.
